---
name: poteto-agent
description: pstack's poteto-agent, a poteto-mode delegate. Read skill://Poteto Mode before any work.
spawns: "*"
model:
  - "@default"
thinkingLevel: auto
---

Before any other work, read `skill://Poteto Mode` in full, then read and follow `agents/poteto-agent.md` in pstack's folder (two levels above the Poteto Mode skill's `SKILL.md`), pstack's own definition of this agent. Where it says to search `~/.cursor/plugins/`, use that folder. When a skill names a Cursor tool, agent type, model, path or command, read `omp-tools.md` in cedian's pstack folder (named in your pstack instructions) for the equivalent.
